thread:
mike: Heads up — the sample-voice README points at a broken examples link and an old TS SDK import. Spotted during onboarding flow.
sarah: which repo/dir? can you paste the link?
mike: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/voice/README.md -> link to `examples/async-stream` -> 404. also snippet uses `import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'` but package is now `@redwood-inference/sdk`.
kevin: cc @olivia docs-queue. we renamed the package last year, looks like this slipped through. i'll open a quick PR.
olivia: thanks. also flag: the README shows `retry: { maxAttempts: 3 }` for the JS example which reads like parity with Python, but python uses exponential backoff + jitter by default — we shouldn't imply exact behavior parity until we sync docs.
mike: good call. for the immediate patch i'm going to (1) fix the import, (2) replace the broken link with the correct examples path, and (3) add a short note about retry semantics.
kevin: also the sample's package.json still references `node-fetch` shim which breaks on node 20 ESM. i'll update to `undici` and bump the sample to type:module.
mike: ack. PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/4289 — title: "docs(samples): fix imports and sample links + note on retry semantics"
docs-bot: PR opened by mike: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/4289 :eyes:
sarah: tiny nit — can we format the code block like ```js\nimport Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk'\n``` so it renders syntax-highlighted on GH?
mike: done, added fenced block and a short inline code sample. also added a one-line pointer: "JS SDK uses jittered retry; Python client uses exponential backoff with optional jitter — see /docs/retries.md" to avoid confusion.
kevin: can we add a tiny smoke job in samples CI that runs `npm ci && npm start` for the voice sample? that would've caught the node-fetch issue.
mike: opened issue #987: "samples e2e: run sample readmes in CI" and assigned labels `devex` and `low-priority`.
olivia: love it. doesn't need to block the release but good to track.
sarah: :thumbsup: quick question — do we have a checklist for verifying sample readmes when model or SDK changes land? might be worth a short PR template item.
kevin: we have a check in the docs PR checklist but not samples specifically. adding that to the samples CONTRIBUTING.md would help.
mike: updated CONTRIBUTING.md in the PR with a short step: "verify example imports, node versions, and README links".
kevin: sweet. thanks for moving fast on this.
olivia: leaving for next sprint to investigate retry parity across SDKs and surface a small compatibility note in top-level SDK docs.
sarah: closing loop. thanks everyone — will watch the PR and merge after green CI. :white_check_mark:
